title: Owner action: make the repository private, revoke the old token, list secrets to rotate
goal: Stop the public GitHub repository from exposing the code and old secrets, and write down every secret that must be replaced before go-live.
why: sn-arjun/travel-crm is PUBLIC (verified 2026-10-14). backend/.dev.vars was committed in c668ebd and 6d75a0b; super-admin/wrangler.toml carries default super admin credentials and a placeholder JWT secret; a GitHub token was embedded in the old remote URL. Nothing new may be pushed until the repository is private.
blockedOnOwner: owner action: GitHub settings and token revocation
steps: OWNER: GitHub > sn-arjun/travel-crm > Settings > General > Danger zone > Change visibility > Private. Confirm with `gh repo view sn-arjun/travel-crm --json visibility` (expects PRIVATE).

OWNER: GitHub > Settings > Developer settings > Personal access tokens: revoke the token that was in the old remote URL; run `gh auth login` to create a fresh credential. Orchestrator confirms `git remote -v` shows no token.

ORCHESTRATOR (no code change): list in docs/launch/SECRETS-TO-ROTATE.md every secret name (never a value) that appeared in public master history or tracked files: everything in backend/.dev.vars at c668ebd and 6d75a0b (use `git show c668ebd:backend/.dev.vars | cut -d= -f1`), SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL/SUPER_ADMIN_PASSWORD/JWT_SECRET defaults in super-admin/wrangler.toml and their code fallbacks (super-admin/src/middleware.ts, src/lib/session.ts, src/app/api/auth/route.ts, src/app/api/auth/seed/route.ts, terraform/variables.tf), the seeded local admin password (backend/scripts/seed-local.mjs, dev only), and the GitHub token. For each: where it is used, and "rotate at go-live: generate fresh, never reuse".
ORCHESTRATOR: confirm with `git log --all --oneline -- backend/.dev.vars` that no newer commit re-adds the file, and that .gitignore still ignores it.
acceptance: `gh repo view sn-arjun/travel-crm --json visibility` prints PRIVATE.
docs/launch/SECRETS-TO-ROTATE.md lists names and locations only, no values.
goLiveVerify: Every secret in SECRETS-TO-ROTATE.md is regenerated for production (GO-LIVE runbook step "rotate every secret").
notes: This is the only Tier 1 item that is not code. Nothing is pushed (W1a push, R118 CI) until it is done.
Do not rewrite git history for this; the values are treated as exposed and rotated instead.
